To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we design the first CCA AHNIPEs from plain DDH and KerMDH assumptions, and we build the first CCA anonymous IBR scheme solely based on plain assumptions.
We present a generic transformation of a chosen ciphertext secure attribute hiding NIPE from a functional encryption scheme and a quasi-adaptable non-interactive zero knowledge proof system.
we propose a novel attribute-hiding NIPIKE (AHNIPE), which is a new encryption primitive, from a generic transformation of IPFEs and QANIZK proofs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of AHNIPEs and their applications to anonymous identity-based revocable systems.
the design of AHNIPEs, their applications in anonymous IBR and anonymous trace and revoked schemes, which are secure against active attacks.
the design of attribute-hiding non-zero inner product encryption with CCA security, and its applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work presents a generic construction for attribute-hiding chosen ciphertext secure NIPEs and its applications.

our AHNIPE construction is the most efficient CCA secure AH-IPFE scheme from a minimal assumption to date, which in turn can be used to construct a CCA secure IB-Revocation scheme with the most efficient revocation mechanism to date.
our work is the first to provide a generic transformation of a CCA AHNIPE from an IPFE and a QANIZK proof system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide the first CCA security for AHNIPE and its applications based on plain assumptions.
we propose a generic transformation of CCA secure AHNIEP and build concrete constructions of AHNIEP from various assumptions.
we provide the first CCA-secure AHNIPE and a few efficient applications based on plain DDHI assumption in the standard-model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
AHNIPEs are useful for designing efficient anonymous IBR schemes with CCA security based on plain assumptions.
we can construct CCA secure AHNIPEs and applications thereof based on a variety of assumptions.
the AHNIPE primitive is very useful in designing anonymous CCA secure cryptographic schemes.
